```{r}
counts <- GetAssayData(DCM_RV, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")

cell_types <- levels(Idents(DCM_RV))

# Function to compute % expressing for a given set of cells
pct_expressing <- function(cell_vec) {
  m <- counts[goi, cell_vec, drop = FALSE]
  (Matrix::rowSums(m > 0) / ncol(m)) * 100
}

pcts_by_type <- sapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  cells_ct <- Seurat::WhichCells(DCM_RV, idents = ct)
  if (length(cells_ct) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, length(goi)))
  pct_expressing(cells_ct)
}, simplify = "matrix")

pcts_by_type <- t(pcts_by_type)               

pcts_total <- pct_expressing(colnames(DCM_RV))
names(pcts_total) <- goi

percent_df <- rbind(pcts_by_type, tot = pcts_total)
percent_df <- as.data.frame(round(percent_df, 4))
percent_df$Cell_type <- rownames(percent_df)

write_csv(percent_df, here::here(output_dir_data, "Percent_per_cell_type.csv"))

reactable(percent_df, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
          defaultPageSize = 14)
```

```{r}
DCM_RV$pseudobulk <- "pseudobulk"

pseudocounts_all <- Seurat2PB(DCM_RV, sample="Sample", cluster = "pseudobulk")
keep_samples <- pseudocounts_all$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pseudocounts_all <- pseudocounts_all[, keep_samples]

pseudocounts_all <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_all)

colnames(pseudocounts_all) <- pseudocounts_all$samples$sample
counts_pseudocounts_all <- cpm(pseudocounts_all, log = TRUE)
```

```{r}
metadata <- DCM_RV@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Batch_processing, Batch_sequencing, Age_years, Sex, Group, mPAP_mmHg, sPAP_mmHg, PCW_mmHg, PVR_WU, TAPSE_mm, RVID_mm, LVEF_percent, LVEDD_mm) %>%
  unique() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, names(table(DCM_RV$Sample))))

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Sample

write_csv(metadata, here::here(output_dir_data, "Patients_metadata.csv"))

reactable(metadata, 
          filterable = TRUE,
          searchable = TRUE,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
present_genes <- intersect(goi, rownames(counts_pseudocounts_all))
missing_genes <- setdiff(goi, rownames(counts_pseudocounts_all))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  message("Warning: not found in pseudobulk matrix -> ", paste(missing_genes, collapse=", "))
}
stopifnot(length(present_genes) > 0)

expr_long <- counts_pseudocounts_all[present_genes, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Sample") %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "Sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(present_genes), names_to = "gene", values_to = "logCPM") %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("HC","DCM")),
    gene  = factor(gene, levels = goi) 
  )

stopifnot(all(expr_long$Sample %in% rownames(metadata)))

wilcox_tbl <- expr_long %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_HC  = sum(Group == "HC"),
    n_DCM = sum(Group == "DCM"),
    median_HC  = median(logCPM[Group == "HC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_DCM = median(logCPM[Group == "DCM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_median = median_DCM - median_HC,
    p_wilcox = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(logCPM ~ Group)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_wilcox, method = "BH"))
print(wilcox_tbl)

write_csv(wilcox_tbl, "Pseudobulk_all.csv")

p <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = Group, y = logCPM, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Group), width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    comparisons = list(c("HC","DCM")),
    label = "p.format",
    label.y.npc = 0.98,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "logCPM",
       title = "Pseudobulk all cells") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(HC = "#4C78A8", DCM = "#F58518")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(HC = "#4C78A8", DCM = "#F58518")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 10))

print(p)

```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=9}
pb_ct <- Seurat2PB(DCM_RV, sample = "Sample", cluster = "cell_type")

keep_cols <- pb_ct$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pb_ct <- pb_ct[, keep_cols, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

pb_ct <- edgeR::normLibSizes(pb_ct)
logcpm_ct <- edgeR::cpm(pb_ct, log = TRUE)

col_annot <- pb_ct$samples %>%
  dplyr::transmute(Sample = .data$sample, cell_type = .data$cluster) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "Sample")


colnames(logcpm_ct) <- paste(col_annot$Sample, col_annot$cell_type, sep = "::")

min_detect <- 10

counts_ct <- pb_ct$counts                        
present_genes <- intersect(goi, rownames(counts_ct))
missing_genes  <- setdiff(goi, rownames(counts_ct))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  message("Warning: not found in pseudobulk matrix -> ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))
}
stopifnot(length(present_genes) > 0)

det_tbl <- lapply(present_genes, function(g) {
  data.frame(
    cell_type = col_annot$cell_type,
    detected  = as.integer(counts_ct[g, ] > 0)
  ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(cell_type) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_detect = sum(detected), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(gene = g)
}) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

keep_pairs <- det_tbl |>
  dplyr::filter(n_detect >= min_detect) |>
  dplyr::transmute(key = paste(cell_type, gene, sep = "||")) |>
  dplyr::pull(key)

expr_long_ct <- logcpm_ct[present_genes, , drop = FALSE] |>
  t() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "col_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample    = sub("::.*$", "", col_id),
    cell_type = sub("^.*::", "", col_id)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "Sample") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(present_genes),
                      names_to = "gene", values_to = "logCPM") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    key       = paste(cell_type, gene, sep = "||"),
    keep      = key %in% keep_pairs,
    Group     = factor(Group, levels = c("HC", "DCM")),
    gene      = factor(gene, levels = goi)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(keep) |>
  dplyr::select(-keep, -key)


expr_long_ct <- droplevels(expr_long_ct)

wilcox_ct <- expr_long_ct |>
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type, gene) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_HC  = sum(Group == "HC"),
    n_DCM = sum(Group == "DCM"),
    median_HC  = median(logCPM[Group == "HC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_DCM = median(logCPM[Group == "DCM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_median = median_DCM - median_HC,
    p_wilcox = tryCatch(wilcox.test(logCPM ~ Group)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene) |>
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj_BH_within_gene = p.adjust(p_wilcox, method = "BH")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

write_csv(expr_long_ct, here::here(output_dir_data, "Pseudobulk_expr_cell_type.csv"))

readr::write_csv(wilcox_ct, "Pseudobulk_byCellType_wilcox.csv")

make_gene_plot <- function(df, g, ncol_facets = 3, base_size = 11) {
  df_g <- df %>% filter(gene == g)
  ggplot(df_g, aes(x = Group, y = logCPM, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = Group), width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.9) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      method = "wilcox.test",
      comparisons = list(c("HC","DCM")),
      label = "p.format",
      label.y.npc = 0.98,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 3
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ cell_type, ncol = ncol_facets, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "logCPM",
         title = paste("Pseudobulk by cell type -", as.character(g))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(HC = "#4C78A8", DCM = "#F58518")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(HC = "#4C78A8", DCM = "#F58518")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 16, 8, 8)
    )
}

# genes to plot (preserve your order)
genes_to_plot <- intersect(levels(expr_long_ct$gene), goi)

# build plots
plots <- lapply(genes_to_plot, function(g) make_gene_plot(expr_long_ct, g, ncol_facets = 3))

# compute number of facet rows per gene (for proportional heights)
rows_per_gene <- sapply(genes_to_plot, function(g) {
  n_ct <- expr_long_ct %>% filter(gene == g) %>% pull(cell_type) %>% n_distinct()
  ceiling(n_ct / 3)  # 3 columns
})

# scale to heights (each row gets the same height unit)
heights_vec <- rows_per_gene / sum(rows_per_gene)

# stack with proportional heights
p_stack <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1) + plot_layout(heights = heights_vec)
print(p_stack)
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
metadata <- DCM_RV@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Batch_processing, Batch_sequencing, Age_years, Sex, Group,
                mPAP_mmHg, sPAP_mmHg, PCW_mmHg, PVR_WU, TAPSE_mm, RVID_mm,
                LVEF_percent, LVEDD_mm) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TAPSE_sPAP = dplyr::if_else(sPAP_mmHg > 0, TAPSE_mm / sPAP_mmHg, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  unique() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, names(table(DCM_RV$Sample))))

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Sample
metadata_DCM <- metadata %>% filter(Group == "DCM")

dcm_samples_all <- intersect(colnames(counts_pseudocounts_all), metadata_DCM$Sample)

counts_all_raw     <- pseudocounts_all$counts
present_genes_all  <- intersect(goi, rownames(counts_all_raw))
det_counts_all     <- sapply(present_genes_all, function(g)
  sum(counts_all_raw[g, dcm_samples_all, drop = FALSE] > 0)
)
genes_keep_all     <- names(det_counts_all[det_counts_all >= 10])

expr_all_long_DCM <- counts_pseudocounts_all[genes_keep_all, dcm_samples_all, drop = FALSE] %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(metadata_DCM, by = "Sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genes_keep_all), names_to = "gene", values_to = "logCPM") %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = goi))

make_allcells_panel <- function(df, xvar, xlab) {
  ggplot(df, aes_string(x = xvar, y = "logCPM")) +
    geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, size = 0.5) +
    ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.y.npc = 0.95, size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "logCPM")
}

genes_to_plot <- intersect(goi, unique(as.character(expr_all_long_DCM$gene)))
expr_all_long_DCM$gene <- factor(expr_all_long_DCM$gene, levels = genes_to_plot)

p_all_mpap <- make_allcells_panel(
  df   = expr_all_long_DCM %>% filter(!is.na(mPAP_mmHg), !is.na(logCPM)),
  xvar = "mPAP_mmHg", xlab = "mPAP (mmHg)"
)
p_all_tapse <- make_allcells_panel(
  df   = expr_all_long_DCM %>% filter(!is.na(TAPSE_mm), !is.na(logCPM)),
  xvar = "TAPSE_mm",  xlab = "TAPSE (mm)"
)

fig_allcells <- (p_all_mpap / p_all_tapse) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.25)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "Pseudobulk all cells")
print(fig_allcells)

is_dcm_ct       <- col_annot$Sample %in% metadata_DCM$Sample
logcpm_ct_DCM   <- logcpm_ct[, is_dcm_ct, drop = FALSE]
col_ann_DCM     <- col_annot[is_dcm_ct, , drop = FALSE]
colnames(logcpm_ct_DCM) <- paste(col_ann_DCM$Sample, col_ann_DCM$cell_type, sep = "::")

counts_ct_DCM    <- counts_ct[, is_dcm_ct, drop = FALSE]
present_genes_ct <- intersect(goi, rownames(counts_ct_DCM))

det_tbl_DCM <- lapply(present_genes_ct, function(g) {
  tibble(cell_type = col_ann_DCM$cell_type,
         detected  = as.integer(counts_ct_DCM[g, ] > 0)) %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>%
    summarise(n_detect = sum(detected), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(gene = g)
}) %>% bind_rows()

keep_pairs_DCM <- det_tbl_DCM %>%
  filter(n_detect >= 10) %>%
  transmute(key = paste(cell_type, gene, sep = "||")) %>%
  pull(key)

expr_ct_long_DCM <- logcpm_ct_DCM[present_genes_ct, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("col_id") %>%
  mutate(Sample = sub("::.*$", "", col_id),
         cell_type = sub("^.*::", "", col_id)) %>%
  left_join(metadata_DCM, by = "Sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(present_genes_ct),
               names_to = "gene", values_to = "logCPM") %>%
  mutate(key = paste(cell_type, gene, sep = "||")) %>%
  filter(key %in% keep_pairs_DCM) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = goi),
         cell_type = droplevels(factor(cell_type))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-key, -col_id)

plot_perct_vs <- function(df, gene_id, xvar, xlab, ncol_facets = 3) {
  dfg <- df %>% filter(gene == gene_id, !is.na(.data[[xvar]]))
  ggplot(dfg, aes_string(x = xvar, y = "logCPM")) +
    geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, size = 0.5) +
    ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.y.npc = 0.95, size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ cell_type, ncol = ncol_facets, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(title = paste0(as.character(gene_id), " - per cell type"),
         x = xlab, y = "logCPM")
}

g <- "TRHDE-AS1"
p_ct_mpap  <- plot_perct_vs(expr_ct_long_DCM, g, "mPAP_mmHg", "mPAP (mmHg)")
p_ct_tapse <- plot_perct_vs(expr_ct_long_DCM, g, "TAPSE_mm",  "TAPSE (mm)")

rows_mpap  <- expr_ct_long_DCM %>% filter(gene == g, !is.na(mPAP_mmHg)) %>%
               pull(cell_type) %>% n_distinct() %>% {max(1, ceiling(. / 3))}
rows_tapse <- expr_ct_long_DCM %>% filter(gene == g, !is.na(TAPSE_mm)) %>%
               pull(cell_type) %>% n_distinct() %>% {max(1, ceiling(. / 3))}

fig_ct_TRHDE <- (p_ct_mpap / p_ct_tapse) + plot_layout(heights = c(rows_mpap, rows_tapse))
print(fig_ct_TRHDE)

```

```{r}
# Correlations for DCM only (by cell type), per cell_type × gene
safe_cor_ct <- function(df, xvar) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[xvar]]), !is.na(logCPM)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_type, gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n        = dplyr::n(),
      r        = suppressWarnings(cor(logCPM, .data[[xvar]], method = "pearson")),
      p_value  = tryCatch(cor.test(logCPM, .data[[xvar]], method = "pearson")$p.value,
                          error = function(e) NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      variable = xvar,
      p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
    )
}

corr_byCT_DCM <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  safe_cor_ct(expr_ct_long_DCM, "mPAP_mmHg"),
  safe_cor_ct(expr_ct_long_DCM, "TAPSE_mm")
)

readr::write_csv(corr_byCT_DCM,
                 here::here(output_dir_data, "Correlations_byCellType_DCM.csv"))
```

```{r}
  dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, names(table(DCM_RV$Sample))))
```

```{r}
# Correlations for DCM only (by cell type), per cell_type × gene
safe_cor_ct <- function(df, xvar) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[xvar]]), !is.na(logCPM)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_type, gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n        = dplyr::n(),
      r        = suppressWarnings(cor(logCPM, .data[[xvar]], method = "pearson")),
      p_value  = tryCatch(cor.test(logCPM, .data[[xvar]], method = "pearson")$p.value,
                          error = function(e) NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      variable = xvar,
      p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
    )
}

corr_byCT_DCM <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  safe_cor_ct(expr_ct_long_DCM, "mPAP_mmHg"),
  safe_cor_ct(expr_ct_long_DCM, "TAPSE_mm"),
  safe_cor_ct(expr_ct_long_DCM, "TAPSE_sPAP")
)

readr::write_csv(corr_byCT_DCM,
                 here::here(output_dir_data, "Correlations_byCellType_DCM.csv"))
```

```{r}
counts <- GetAssayData(DCM_RV, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")

cell_types <- levels(Idents(DCM_RV))

# Function to compute % expressing for a given set of cells
pct_expressing <- function(cell_vec) {
  m <- counts[goi, cell_vec, drop = FALSE]
  (Matrix::rowSums(m > 0) / ncol(m)) * 100
}

pcts_by_type <- sapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  cells_ct <- Seurat::WhichCells(DCM_RV, idents = ct)
  if (length(cells_ct) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, length(goi)))
  pct_expressing(cells_ct)
}, simplify = "matrix")

pcts_by_type <- t(pcts_by_type)               

pcts_total <- pct_expressing(colnames(DCM_RV))
names(pcts_total) <- goi

percent_df <- rbind(pcts_by_type, tot = pcts_total)
percent_df <- as.data.frame(round(percent_df, 4))
percent_df$Cell_type <- rownames(percent_df)

write_csv(percent_df, here::here(output_dir_data, "Percent_per_cell_type_2.csv"))

reactable(percent_df, 
          filterable = TRUE,

          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
```

```{r, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=3}
    diff_median = median_DCM - median_HC,

      wilcox.test(logCPM ~ Group)$p.value,
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=7}
pb_ct <- Seurat2PB(DCM_RV, sample = "Sample", cluster = "cell_type")

keep_cols <- pb_ct$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pb_ct <- pb_ct[, keep_cols, keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

pb_ct <- edgeR::normLibSizes(pb_ct)
logcpm_ct <- edgeR::cpm(pb_ct, log = TRUE)

col_annot <- pb_ct$samples %>%
  dplyr::transmute(Sample = .data$sample, cell_type = .data$cluster) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "Sample")


colnames(logcpm_ct) <- paste(col_annot$Sample, col_annot$cell_type, sep = "::")

min_detect <- 10

counts_ct <- pb_ct$counts                        
present_genes <- intersect(goi, rownames(counts_ct))
missing_genes  <- setdiff(goi, rownames(counts_ct))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  message("Warning: not found in pseudobulk matrix -> ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))
}
stopifnot(length(present_genes) > 0)

det_tbl <- lapply(present_genes, function(g) {
  data.frame(
    cell_type = col_annot$cell_type,
    detected  = as.integer(counts_ct[g, ] > 0)
  ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(cell_type) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_detect = sum(detected), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(gene = g)
}) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

keep_pairs <- det_tbl |>
  dplyr::filter(n_detect >= min_detect) |>
  dplyr::transmute(key = paste(cell_type, gene, sep = "||")) |>
  dplyr::pull(key)

expr_long_ct <- logcpm_ct[present_genes, , drop = FALSE] |>
  t() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "col_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample    = sub("::.*$", "", col_id),
    cell_type = sub("^.*::", "", col_id)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "Sample") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(present_genes),
                      names_to = "gene", values_to = "logCPM") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    key       = paste(cell_type, gene, sep = "||"),
    keep      = key %in% keep_pairs,
    Group     = factor(Group, levels = c("HC", "DCM")),
    gene      = factor(gene, levels = goi)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(keep) |>
  dplyr::select(-keep, -key)


expr_long_ct <- droplevels(expr_long_ct)

wilcox_ct <- expr_long_ct |>
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type, gene) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_HC  = sum(Group == "HC"),
    n_DCM = sum(Group == "DCM"),
    median_HC  = median(logCPM[Group == "HC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_DCM = median(logCPM[Group == "DCM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_median = median_DCM - median_HC,
    p_wilcox = tryCatch(wilcox.test(logCPM ~ Group)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(gene) |>
  dplyr::mutate(p_adj_BH_within_gene = p.adjust(p_wilcox, method = "BH")) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

write_csv(expr_long_ct, here::here(output_dir_data, "Pseudobulk_expr_cell_type_2.csv"))

readr::write_csv(wilcox_ct, "Pseudobulk_byCellType_wilcox_2.csv")

make_gene_plot <- function(df, g, ncol_facets = 3, base_size = 11) {
  df_g <- df %>% filter(gene == g)
  ggplot(df_g, aes(x = Group, y = logCPM, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = Group), width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.9) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      method = "wilcox.test",
      comparisons = list(c("HC","DCM")),
      label = "p.format",
      label.y.npc = 0.98,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 3
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ cell_type, ncol = ncol_facets, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "logCPM",
         title = paste("Pseudobulk by cell type -", as.character(g))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(HC = "#4C78A8", DCM = "#F58518")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(HC = "#4C78A8", DCM = "#F58518")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 16, 8, 8)
    )
}

# genes to plot (preserve your order)
genes_to_plot <- intersect(levels(expr_long_ct$gene), goi)

# build plots
plots <- lapply(genes_to_plot, function(g) make_gene_plot(expr_long_ct, g, ncol_facets = 3))

# compute number of facet rows per gene (for proportional heights)
rows_per_gene <- sapply(genes_to_plot, function(g) {
  n_ct <- expr_long_ct %>% filter(gene == g) %>% pull(cell_type) %>% n_distinct()
  ceiling(n_ct / 3)  # 3 columns
})

# scale to heights (each row gets the same height unit)
heights_vec <- rows_per_gene / sum(rows_per_gene)

# stack with proportional heights
p_stack <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1) + plot_layout(heights = heights_vec)
print(p_stack)
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
  tibble::rownames_to_column("col_id") %>%
  mutate(Sample = sub("::.*$", "", col_id),
         cell_type = sub("^.*::", "", col_id)) %>%
  left_join(metadata_DCM, by = "Sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(present_genes_ct),
               names_to = "gene", values_to = "logCPM") %>%
  mutate(key = paste(cell_type, gene, sep = "||")) %>%
  filter(key %in% keep_pairs_DCM) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = goi),
         cell_type = droplevels(factor(cell_type))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-key, -col_id)

plot_perct_vs <- function(df, gene_id, xvar, xlab, ncol_facets = 3) {
  dfg <- df %>% filter(gene == gene_id, !is.na(.data[[xvar]]))
  ggplot(dfg, aes_string(x = xvar, y = "logCPM")) +
    geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, size = 0.5) +
    ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.y.npc = 0.95, size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ cell_type, ncol = ncol_facets, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(title = paste0(as.character(gene_id), " - per cell type"),
         x = xlab, y = "logCPM")
}

g <- "LINC02158"
p_ct_mpap  <- plot_perct_vs(expr_ct_long_DCM, g, "mPAP_mmHg", "mPAP (mmHg)")
p_ct_tapse <- plot_perct_vs(expr_ct_long_DCM, g, "TAPSE_mm",  "TAPSE (mm)")

rows_mpap  <- expr_ct_long_DCM %>% filter(gene == g, !is.na(mPAP_mmHg)) %>%
               pull(cell_type) %>% n_distinct() %>% {max(1, ceiling(. / 3))}
rows_tapse <- expr_ct_long_DCM %>% filter(gene == g, !is.na(TAPSE_mm)) %>%
               pull(cell_type) %>% n_distinct() %>% {max(1, ceiling(. / 3))}

fig_ct_TRHDE <- (p_ct_mpap / p_ct_tapse) + plot_layout(heights = c(rows_mpap, rows_tapse))
print(fig_ct_TRHDE)

```

```{r}
# Correlations for DCM only (by cell type), per cell_type × gene
safe_cor_ct <- function(df, xvar) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[xvar]]), !is.na(logCPM)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_type, gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n        = dplyr::n(),
      r        = suppressWarnings(cor(logCPM, .data[[xvar]], method = "pearson")),
      p_value  = tryCatch(cor.test(logCPM, .data[[xvar]], method = "pearson")$p.value,
                          error = function(e) NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      variable = xvar,
      p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
    )
}

corr_byCT_DCM <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  safe_cor_ct(expr_ct_long_DCM, "mPAP_mmHg"),
  safe_cor_ct(expr_ct_long_DCM, "TAPSE_mm")
)

readr::write_csv(corr_byCT_DCM,
                 here::here(output_dir_data, "Correlations_byCellType_DCM_2.csv"))
```

```{r}
metadata <- DCM_RV@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample, Batch_processing, Batch_sequencing, Age_years, Sex, Group,
    mPAP_mmHg, sPAP_mmHg, PCW_mmHg, PVR_WU, TAPSE_mm, RVID_mm,
    LVEF_percent, LVEDD_mm
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TAPSE_sPAP = dplyr::if_else(sPAP_mmHg > 0, TAPSE_mm / sPAP_mmHg, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  unique() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, names(table(DCM_RV$Sample))))

          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

```{r, fig.height=7.5, fig.width=8}
metadata_DCM <- metadata %>% filter(Group == "DCM")

dcm_samples_all <- intersect(colnames(counts_pseudocounts_all), metadata_DCM$Sample)

counts_all_raw     <- pseudocounts_all$counts
present_genes_all  <- intersect(goi, rownames(counts_all_raw))
det_counts_all     <- sapply(present_genes_all, function(g)
  sum(counts_all_raw[g, dcm_samples_all, drop = FALSE] > 0)
)
genes_keep_all     <- names(det_counts_all[det_counts_all >= 10])

expr_all_long_DCM <- counts_pseudocounts_all[genes_keep_all, dcm_samples_all, drop = FALSE] %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
  left_join(metadata_DCM, by = "Sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(genes_keep_all), names_to = "gene", values_to = "logCPM") %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = goi))

make_allcells_panel <- function(df, xvar, xlab) {
  ggplot(df, aes_string(x = xvar, y = "logCPM")) +
    geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, size = 0.5) +
    ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.y.npc = 0.95, size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "logCPM")
}

genes_to_plot <- intersect(goi, unique(as.character(expr_all_long_DCM$gene)))
expr_all_long_DCM$gene <- factor(expr_all_long_DCM$gene, levels = genes_to_plot)

p_all_mpap <- make_allcells_panel(
  df   = expr_all_long_DCM %>% filter(!is.na(mPAP_mmHg), !is.na(logCPM)),
  xvar = "mPAP_mmHg", xlab = "mPAP (mmHg)"
)
p_all_tapse <- make_allcells_panel(
  df   = expr_all_long_DCM %>% filter(!is.na(TAPSE_mm), !is.na(logCPM)),
  xvar = "TAPSE_mm",  xlab = "TAPSE (mm)"
)
# NEW: TAPSE/sPAP ratio
p_all_ratio <- make_allcells_panel(
  df   = expr_all_long_DCM %>% filter(!is.na(TAPSE_sPAP), !is.na(logCPM)),
  xvar = "TAPSE_sPAP", xlab = "TAPSE / sPAP"
)

fig_allcells <- (p_all_mpap / p_all_tapse / p_all_ratio) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1.25)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "Pseudobulk all cells")
print(fig_allcells)
```
